newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes higher, yen/dlr trends watched.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes higher, yen/dlr trends watched.

text.p: South Korean won closed higher than the previous close on Monday, but much of its early sharp rises were offset by the central bank's dollar buying, dealers said.
The won closed at 891.70, against Friday's closing rate of 893.10 won. But Monday's closing level was far off the day's high and opening rate of 885.00.
Dealers said the Bank of Korea heavily bought dollars soon after trading started, immediately pushing up the local currency. Officials at the bank declined to comment.
The won's early strength was in line with the yen's rise against the dollar over the weekend in international markets.
On Monday, the yen leapt as high as 117.60 yen to the dollar in Tokyo, against 123.11/21 yen at late afternoon on Friday.
Dealers expected the won to move at around the 890 won level for the time being unless the yen/dollar rises sharply again.
